description: Compute the area reachable from an origin within one or more travel-time budgets — walkability/cyclability rings. Costing "pedestrian" answers "how far can I walk in 15 minutes?", "bicycle" the cycling equivalent; "auto", "truck" and "motor_scooter" work too (e.g. delivery coverage). `contours_minutes` lists the ring boundaries in minutes (1-10 values, each up to 120); set `polygons` true for filled polygons ready to render as a map fill layer instead of contour lines. Returns a GeoJSON FeatureCollection, one feature per contour. Optional `exclude_polygons` for before/after scenarios ("close this bridge and recompute reachability"): an array of polygons, each an array of [lon, lat] pairs forming one ring — longitude FIRST — whose intersecting roads are excluded from the reachability search. Applies to the Valhalla engine; unsupported on the GraphHopper engine, where it is ignored.

CostingKind.description:
Costing models exposed by the MCP tools (a deliberate subset of the
Valhalla costing list), serialised in snake_case exactly as Valhalla
names them.

oneOf.description:
Truck costing; honours dimensional limits and, when a `truck`
profile is supplied, ADR dangerous-goods restrictions.
Bicycle costing; tune it with a `bicycle` options object.

Pedestrian (walking) costing; tune it with a `pedestrian` options
object (lit streets, wheelchair/blind, hiking difficulty).

Motor scooter (moped) costing: like auto but prefers lower-speed
roads and may use ways closed to larger motor vehicles.

LatLon.description: A WGS84 coordinate in decimal degrees: a {lat, lon} object (preferred), or a GeoJSON [lon, lat] array with LONGITUDE FIRST, the same order as every polygon field on this server.

contours_minutes.description:
Contour boundaries in minutes of travel time, e.g. [5, 10, 15]
for 5/10/15-minute rings. 1–10 values, each between 0 and 120
minutes.

exclude_polygons.description:
Areas to avoid — scenario analysis ("close this bridge and
recompute reachability"): an array of polygons, each an array of
`[lon, lat]` pairs forming one exterior ring (GeoJSON-style,
longitude FIRST). Roads intersecting any ring are excluded from
the reachability search. Applies to the Valhalla engine;
unsupported on the GraphHopper engine, where it is ignored.

origin.description: Origin the reachable area is computed from.

polygons.description:
Return filled polygons instead of contour linestrings (default
false). Polygons draw directly as a MapLibre fill layer.

name: reachable_area

geojson.description:
GeoJSON FeatureCollection of the reachability contours, one
feature per requested minute value (each feature's `contour`
property is its minutes), as returned by the routing engine.
